title: THE WAITING OF LAST MEETING
summary: A story of love, memories, separation and an unfinished wait.
body:
**Chapter 2 — The Little Things That Brought Us Closer**

After she arrived, our lives slowly began to settle into a new routine.
At first, we were just two people who didn't know much about each other. Our conversations were simple, and most of the time, we talked about ordinary things.
But gradually, those small conversations started becoming part of our everyday lives.
There was a reason she had come. She wanted to study law and pursue her education at a law college. Before getting admission, she needed to prepare for an entrance examination.
I knew that her studies were important to her. So, I started helping her in whatever way I could.
I searched for the best law colleges in the state. I looked for useful books, checked study materials and explored online courses that could help her prepare for the entrance examination.
She spent time studying, sometimes reading aloud from her books and sometimes learning through online resources.
I wasn't the one preparing for the examination, but somewhere in my heart, I genuinely wanted her to succeed.
I wanted her to clear that entrance examination. I wanted to see her move closer to her dream.
Those days were not only about books and studies. They were also about the little things that slowly made our everyday lives more familiar.
Sometimes, while studying, she would feel hungry and want something to eat. Sometimes she needed something from the kitchen or just a little help with ordinary things.
Whenever she needed something, I tried to be there.
It was never about doing something extraordinary. I simply wanted to help whenever I could.
And then there was one little thing I still remember.
She loved momos.
Interestingly, until that time, I had never really eaten momos myself. But when she told me that she wanted to eat them, I went to the market and brought some for her.
She enjoyed eating them.
She also liked South Indian food, and slowly, I started learning about the little things she liked and the things that made her happy.
I began noticing her smile whenever we talked.
She had beautiful eyes, and there was something special about the way she smiled. She often smiled while speaking, and those little expressions gradually became familiar to me.
I didn't realise exactly when these ordinary moments started becoming important.
There were no big promises between us. We were simply spending time, talking, helping each other and getting to know one another.
But sometimes, the smallest moments leave the deepest impressions.
And then came an evening I still remember.
I had returned from work with a terrible headache. My head was hurting so much that I felt as if it might burst. I mentioned the pain to her.
She listened and offered to help.
She asked me to come  and offered to give me a gentle head massage .
It was a simple offer of care, something that might seem ordinary to another person. But for me, that moment carried a different feeling.
I had been there for her in many little ways, and now she was offering her care to me.
I didn't know what that moment would mean for our relationship.
I didn't know whether to accept her invitation or what would happen next.
But that evening, when she asked me to come to her room, I had no idea that my next step might change the story of two strangers forever.
